acceptanceCriteria.text: A FAILABLE lint counts room/identity creations by test code and asserts ZERO outside the ONE recorded SystemTester room (uuid 909f1bd6). stub-must-fail: add a createRoom outside the fixed room -> RED. Ratchet baseline never increases; touch-it-fix-it converges toward zero.

gateRef.assertion: room/identity creations outside fixed room 909f1bd6 counted; above-baseline creation => RED; ratchet 52/52 room-create + 0/0 identity-mint at baseline

satisfaction.evidence: lint VERDICT GREEN — at baseline (52/52 room-create grandfathered, 0/0 identity-mint); fixed room 909f1bd6, identity ce981242

acceptanceCriteria.text: A cleanup can NEVER re-persist a bystander room — STRUCTURAL, not instructional. Writing a room must refuse to blank a member name, move an immutable createdAt, or silently drop a distinct-identity member (the exact 2026-09-07 corruption class). This is the R40.107 room-persist invariant.

gateRef.assertion: GUARD#5 refuses name-blank + createdAt-move; GUARD#6 refuses silent distinct-identity drop (both directions); legit saves pass

satisfaction.evidence: R40.107 room-persist invariant GREEN — #5 refuses name-blank + createdAt-move; #1/#2 preserve identity; #6 allows stub-consolidation + refuses distinct-identity drop

acceptanceCriteria.text: Any manual cleanup running AHEAD of the guard is RECORDED and visible (not implied) until the guard lands — a manual cleanup ahead of its guard is the 2026-09-07 corruption state and must be surfaced as open debt, never silent.

gateRef.assertion: the ahead-of-guard manual cleanup is written on the task row as explicit debt, not implied

satisfaction.evidence: task 24284f6d.remainingIssues carries the OPEN DEBT + CLEANUP-ACCEPTANCE + CONVERGENCE record explicitly (PO-visible)

acceptanceCriteria.text: Cleanup acceptance = a RE-VERIFICATION that the REAL rooms are untouched (names, createdAt, member counts) after the test-room purge — NOT the deletion count. Enumeration reported first, then deletion, then re-verify delta=0 on the real rooms.

gateRef.assertion: post-purge, the real rooms' names/createdAt/member-counts are byte-unchanged (delta=0); acceptance is the re-verify, not the count

satisfaction.evidence: MISSED-SUMMARY 2026-09-09: 72 test rooms deleted + verified null on live surface; 45 real rooms delta=0; fixed room 909f1bd6 is the only gate room. Manual acceptance (tester-owned); re-run on any future purge.
